verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Stripe sends funds from the available balance to the bank as payouts. It also shows that in-person Terminal payments are managed alongside online payments in a unified Dashboard. Together these are only a thin basis for matching takings to payouts; nothing documents reconciliation tooling or itemized reporting. Missing for 10: itemized transaction-to-payout reconciliation reports, per-transaction fee breakdown reports, daily takings summaries or exports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
